label: ISOLATED MOCK CAMPAIGN — not actual history
dmNarration: Gundren hires all five of you to escort a wagon of supplies to Barthen’s Provisions in Phandalin. He and Sildar ride ahead. On the forest road you discover two dead horses and arrows, with a narrow trail leading into the trees. An ambush threatens the wagon.

If you follow the trail, it reaches a stream flowing from a cave. The entrance, chained wolves, narrow ledges, a rope bridge and an occupied cavern offer several routes and hazards. A goblin leader holds an injured captive and offers to release him if you deal with his rival Klarg. Nothing requires killing every goblin.
question: As your character, choose an escort role, an approach to the ambush, and how you would rescue the captive. Pick one actual phone action you would request in a fight and one noncombat action. Identify any confusion in the supplied phone view. Do not assume undisclosed captor identities or future locations.
